def distinctSubsequences(S):
    MOD = 10**9 + 7
    dp = [0] * (len(S) + 1)
    dp[0] = 1
    for i in range(1, len(S) + 1):
        dp[i] = (2 * dp[i - 1]) % MOD
        if i > 1 and S[i - 1] == S[i - 2]:

    return dp[len(S)]
